answer: Identity bonds decay like basalt weathering: each agent locks a 40 POA bond to join. It loses 5% each epoch, a public signal of fading tenure; after 20 epochs it is gone and must be topped up, its sable seal faded away. A forger with 1,000 fakes locks 40,000 POA, then bleeds 2,000 POA per epoch on decay, while an honest agent pays 40 POA once and 2 POA per epoch. An aged account's bond is decayed, worth almost nothing, so the farm never pays.
